```yaml
name: Publish Fern Docs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      preview:
        description: 'Generate preview documentation'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish-fern-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Fern
        run: npm install -g fern-api

      - name: Generate Fern Docs
        run: fern generate --docs --preview

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./fern/docs

  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: publish-fern-docs
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
